Task instruction: Open the foldable laptop using the right arm.

Task description: The target is the light-colored laptop near the center of the table, whose lid is currently slightly open. Use the right arm to increase the opening angle between the lid and base.

Success criteria: Open the lid to at least forty percent of its full opening range while keeping the right end effector near the laptop's specified opening/closing contact point. Opening the lid and moving the end effector away does not count.

## Execution tips

- Choose a straight section on the lid's free edge away from the hinge, accessible to the right arm and with enough pad contact area. Avoid corners to reduce opening force and slipping.
- Match the gripper opening to lid thickness and the existing gap. Confirm the fingers are above and below the lid before closing without also gripping the base. If clearance is insufficient, adjust the approach angle rather than forcing fingertips in.
- When opening, follow the arc of the lid around its hinge with the end-effector position and orientation, avoiding a continuous hard vertical pull or sideways twist that could jam or slip.
